one_line: Indo-Greek king of Sagala, famed conqueror and thoughtful interlocutor of Buddhist tradition.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, tall and athletic with a seasoned soldier’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight Greek nose, sharp jawline, light olive complexion blending Hellenistic and northwestern Indian traits, short well-groomed beard and moustache, intense narrow anime eyes with dark irises, default expression calm and calculating with a faint confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Short, slightly wavy dark brown hair kept above the neck, parted subtly to the right, with a simple bronze Hellenistic diadem band circling the head, plain except for a small central rosette.
appearance.costume: Over a knee-length sleeved white linen chiton belted at the waist, he wears a light bronze cuirass shaped in smooth plates without sculpted muscles, over which is draped a deep teal woolen chlamys cloak clasped on the right shoulder with a round bronze brooch; the chlamys’ edge has a narrow geometric border in dark crimson; his lower body is covered by fitted off-white trousers inspired by steppe and northwestern Indian wear tucked into mid-calf height brown leather boots with simple straps; his forearms bear plain bronze bracers, and he wears a slim bronze ring and a short beaded amulet cord in muted red and brown tones, all textiles rendered in slightly worn, practical textures to signal a campaigning king.
appearance.signature: A long Indo-Greek style spear with an iron leaf-shaped head, ash-wood shaft stained dark, and a small bronze counterweight at the butt, carried in his right hand or resting across his shoulders, with a round bronze shield slung on his back bearing a subtle starburst pattern in teal and bronze.

ref_desc: Menander I is a mid-30s tall athletic Indo-Greek king with light olive skin, short wavy dark brown hair under a simple bronze diadem, wearing a white chiton, bronze cuirass, deep teal bordered chlamys, off-white trousers, brown boots, and bronze bracers, carrying a dark-haft Indo-Greek spear and round bronze shield in a teal, white, bronze, dark crimson, and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Menander I (Milinda) as a dignified Indo-Greek king: a tall, athletic man in his mid-30s with an oval face, light olive complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, short well-groomed beard and moustache, and intense narrow dark eyes, his short slightly wavy dark brown hair kept above the neck and circled by a simple bronze diadem with a small central rosette; dress him in a knee-length sleeved white linen chiton belted at the waist, a smooth-plate bronze cuirass, and a deep teal woolen chlamys cloak clasped on the right shoulder with a round bronze brooch and edged by a thin dark crimson geometric border, plus fitted off-white trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, plain bronze forearm bracers, a slim bronze ring, and a short muted red-and-brown amulet cord, all textiles looking practical and travel-worn; his signature weapon is a long Indo-Greek style spear with a dark ash-wood shaft, iron leaf-shaped head, and bronze counterweight, held in one hand or resting across his shoulders, with a round bronze shield on his back bearing a subtle teal and bronze starburst; show him from multiple angles to emphasize the consistent face, hair, costume details, and the teal, white, bronze, dark crimson, and brown color palette in a heroic, historically grounded style without any fantasy elements.
